details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 586 REMAINS VALID UNTIL 8 PM EDT THIS
EVENING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS

IN PENNSYLVANIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 6 COUNTIES

IN SOUTHWEST PENNSYLVANIA

ALLEGHENY             FAYETTE               GREENE
WASHINGTON            WESTMORELAND

IN WESTERN PENNSYLVANIA

BEAVER

IN WEST VIRGINIA THIS WATCH INCLUDES 4 COUNTIES

IN NORTHEAST WEST VIRGINIA

PRESTON               TUCKER

IN NORTHERN WEST VIRGINIA

MARION                MONONGALIA

THIS INCLUDES THE CITIES OF ALIQUIPPA, AMBRIDGE, BEAVER FALLS,
CANONSBURG, CONNELLSVILLE, DAVIS, FAIRMONT, GREENSBURG, KINGWOOD,
LATROBE, MASONTOWN, MONACA, MORGANTOWN, MURRYSVILLE,
NEW KENSINGTON, PARSONS, PITTSBURGH METRO AREA, TERRA ALTA,
THOMAS, UNIONTOWN, WASHINGTON, AND WAYNESBURG.
